verdict.rationale: The official Solo 2 GitHub README states that the key "also speaks OATH (TOTP/HOTP)" alongside FIDO2/WebAuthn, which covers the legacy OTP schemes in the story. That is the only evidence, though: a single repeated one-line claim with no usage documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of how OATH credentials are provisioned and managed (slot count, CLI/app commands), any mention of challenge-response, and independent or hands-on corroboration that TOTP/HOTP works in practice.
